description: Rubric-based human evaluation of LLM extractions
notes: Machine-readable half of README.md — the two must not drift; change both in one commit.
Uids are sha256(canonical_json(body))[:16]. Timestamps/durations ride storage rows, never the hash.
The evaluated values are immutable here; correcting them is ../annotate/ review mode.

inputs.name: variables_set
inputs.contract: schema variables (registry or schema JSON export)
inputs.description: As ../annotate/: loaded via the library, never redefined.

inputs.name: dataset
inputs.identified_by: input_uid (sha256 of the record text) + optional user id column
inputs.description: As ../annotate/: column roles inferred from structure and types, confirmed before any record is shown.

inputs.name: llm_output
inputs.contract: JSON values per record for the schema `schema_uid` names
inputs.description: What is being judged. A record failing schema validation stays evaluable (rendered read-only raw; target.valid=false).

inputs.name: reference
inputs.contract: annotation-def/1.0 documents (gold), joined by input_uid or input_text_sha256
inputs.description: Optional gold standard; join misses are listed loudly, never dropped silently.

inputs.name: rubric
inputs.description: Authored criteria as data, content-hashed. A default fixture ships in tests/fixtures/; users copy and edit it.

field_verdicts.description: Allowed per-field verdict labels, e.g. correct, minor_error, major_error, missing, spurious, not_evaluable.

outputs.name: evaluation
outputs.written_to: library storage (SQLite default, Postgres when configured)

valid.description: Whether the judged output validated against the schema.

target.description: What was judged — immutable in this app.

field_verdicts.description: Leaf-field path -> {verdict, note?}; list-of-objects fields judged per row (path includes the row index).

criterion_scores.description: Rubric criterion key -> score (string for enum scales, integer for int scales).

outputs.name: export
outputs.contract: projection of stored evaluation-def/1.0 documents + summary sheet (verdict counts, mean scores, agreement rates when references exist)
outputs.identified_by: evaluation_uid per row — the projection carries the document ids it projects
outputs.description: Round-trip requirement as ../annotate/: re-import reproduces identical evaluation_uids, idempotent in storage.
